title: SNU Black Ice Nic Pouches by Bar Juice - 45mg / Pouch
description: SNU Black Ice Nicotine Pouches deliver an intensely cool flavour and a powerful nicotine hit. This extra-strong option combines sharp Menthol with icy Mint for a brisk, refreshing taste that suits those who prefer a strong sensory experience Each pouch contains 45mg of nicotine and is designed for seasoned users seeking maximum strength in a clean, tobacco-free format. The slim, discreet pouches sit comfortably under the lip and provide a gradual nicotine release with no smoke, vapour or odour. The scented can allows you to rub the lid for a preview of the flavour inside. To use, simply place one pouch under your upper lip and leave it in place. The pouch releases nicotine steadily over time for a strong and satisfying effect. When finished, dispose of the pouch responsibly. This product is not recommended for beginners. Nicotine Ranges: Extra Strong- 45mg this is suited for more experienced users ONLY How to Use: Nicotine Pouches Please Note: Do not chew, Suck or Swallow the pouches.
